name: 黑·魔·导
desc: ①：自己场上有「黑魔术师」存在的场合才能发动。对方场上的魔法·陷阱卡全部破坏。
faq: If you activate "Dark Magic Attack", and the "Dark Magician" is removed from the field with "Interdimensional Matter Transporter" or "Compulsory Evacuation Device", or flipped face-down with "Book of Moon", or destroyed by "Ring of Destruction", "Dark Magic Attack"'s effect still resolves.
